hypothesis: Quarter primary trace pixels, one GI ray per sample, reconstructed with dense guides. No expected energy shift.
basis: PERF_AUDIT_GPU proposal 2 planning range, not a measurement

energy.metric: relative difference of float pre-post scene luminance means in dumps.json
energy.band: derive from OFF-a/OFF-b repeats; reject a lower residual with lost energy

cost: Require complete 300-frame GI/reflection windows in every state. At <30 rendered fps extend windows before authorization; no frame-time claim.
scope: Camp High; S8 Medium. One launch per scene, fixed preset geometry per launch. High remains 1.0 by default.
offline_limit: Synthetic replay/PT does not qualify reflection reconstruction, real scene energy or temporal detail.
